precepts.text: Wherefore come out from among them. Saying the same thing. Come out from among them. And be ye separate. Separate your thinking from their thinking. You are not supposed to be hanging around them, hanging out with them. That is wrong. I do not give a damn what they tell you. That is wrong. The Lord did not bring us over here for us to be hanging with them and all of that. I know that sounds like some serious racist talk, but you are the victims of every level of racism. So what is wrong with you? We are the victims of every racist attack. But yet when we say stay away from them, all of a sudden we are racist. My sons end up dead messing around with you, and I am worrying about your feelings? And touch not the unclean thing. Because if you continue to mess around in these philosophies, messing around with their religions, with their politics, messing with any of that stuff, the Bible says that it shall pollute you. And I will receive you. So we will be received in the Most High's nation. That is what he is saying. And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty. In other words, he is building that kingdom when you come away from them. That is the organisation right there. And like the scriptures say, some will lose mothers, some will lose sons, daughters, fathers. You will lose these things, but when you come into this truth you will gain them sevenfold, tenfold. Come out from among them, that is what the Bible said. And ye shall be my sons and daughters, because I am gathering you up. Like Zephaniah said, I am gathering you up, and what you lost you are going to gain it all back again.
precepts.point: Flee out of the midst of Babylon. This is the same thing that is said in Revelation. These three scriptures are saying the same thing.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

precepts.why:
Paul is saying the same thing as Jeremiah and Revelation: “Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord”. Separate your thinking from their thinking. You are not supposed to be hanging around them, hanging out with them. That is wrong. I don't give a damn what they tell you. That is wrong. The Lord did not bring us over here for us to be hanging with them and all of that.

I know that sounds like some serious racist talk, but you are the victims of every level of racism. So what the hell is wrong with you? We are the victims of every racist attack, yet when we say stay away from them, all of a sudden we are racist. The hell with you and your mama. My sons end up dead messing around with you, and I am supposed to worry about your damn feelings? The hell with that.

“and touch not the unclean thing”. If you continue to mess around in these philosophies, with their religions, with their politics, with any of that stuff, it shall pollute you and you will be destroyed by it. “and I will receive you”: we will be received in the Most High's nation.

“And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.” He is building that kingdom when you come away from them. That is the organisation right there. Like the scriptures say, some will lose mothers, some will lose sons, daughters, fathers. You will lose these things, but when you come into this truth you will gain them sevenfold, tenfold. Ye shall be my sons and daughters because I am gathering you up, like Zephaniah said, and what you lost you are going to gain it all back again. That is how every man delivers his soul out of the midst of Babylon.

precepts.text: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins. This is where it came from: God instructed the twelve tribes to separate from these other nations, stop following the customs and traditions of these other nations.
precepts.point: What Paul instructed us in Corinthians is not nothing new. Your churches just have never taught you that. They want to integrate; all churches want to integrate. Remember Philip Anthony: this is not a black church. That was so moving? No, you sound like the devil now. He didn't have to dance with the devil.

note.label: Living Your Life As A Hireling

precepts.why:
“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord”. God is telling us to separate from these nations, these unbelievers. “and touch not the unclean thing”: do not follow their customs, their religions, their holidays or their politics. Only then will God receive us: “and I will receive you”.

What Paul instructed in Corinthians is nothing new. This is where it came from: “And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.” God instructed the twelve tribes to separate from the other nations and stop following the customs and traditions of those nations, and when they returned to him they separated themselves and confessed their sins.

Your churches have just never taught you that. They want to integrate; all churches want to integrate. Remember Philip Anthony: this is not a black church. Was that so moving? No, you sound like the devil now. He did not have to dance with the devil.

So coming out and being separate is the old path of Israel. The seed of Israel separates from the strangers, confesses its sins and the iniquities of the fathers, and then the Lord will be a Father unto us, and we shall be his sons and daughters.

precepts.text: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers, because they will seduce you. What fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? What communion hath light with darkness? What concord hath Christ with Belial? There is no agreement there. An infidel is an unbeliever, an idol worshipper. You think you have the Midas touch and can win them over; you are fooling yourself.
precepts.point: On family: we do not break up families. If your family does not have an issue with you being in the scriptures and is not trying to manipulate your children, fine. But we will warn you if your family is saying come out of that Bible and go back to what you used to do. They will seduce you to go right back to the way you used to be, because that is what the scribes and the Pharisees were doing, and that is what the Christian preachers do.

note.label: Deceived by Enticing Words: Colossians 2

precepts.why:
“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers”. Why? Because they will seduce you to serving Satan once again. But you'll say, no, he's so fine, so divine, I could win him; or, she's so lovely, I could win her over to this truth.

“for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness?” What agreement has righteousness with unrighteousness? “and what communion hath light with darkness?” There is no agreement there. “And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?”

An infidel is an idol worshipper, an unbeliever. You think you've got the Midas touch and can win them over; you are fooling yourself. Being yoked to the unbeliever is how the enticing words get to you, which is exactly what Colossians warns against.

precepts.text: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways: none. Who created Christianity? Esau. Choose none of his ways.
precepts.point: And I will receive you, and will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters: when you cleanse yourself of all the uncleanness this world has to offer, then the Lord will receive you and be a Father to you. Those are not my words; all I am doing is reading and giving you the understanding of the scripture, written long before I was born.

note.label: I Come In Peace

precepts.why:
“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate”. How do you come out? Stop doing the things they are doing; stop following their ways. As Proverbs says, “Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.” None.

If the Bible says choose none of his ways, who is the his? Esau. Who created Christianity? Esau. So you have to let Christianity go. No Jehovah's Witness, none.

Let go of his ways and start choosing to keep God's ways. “and touch not the unclean thing”: your Christmas, let it go; Thanksgiving, let it go; your Christianity, let it go; your masonry, your sororities and fraternities, let them go. Come out.

When you cleanse yourself of all the uncleanness this world has to offer, then the Lord will receive you and be a Father to you, and you shall be his sons and daughters. Those are not our words; they were written long before any of us were born. The churches were given to us by our enemy, and our enemy will never teach us anything right.

precepts.text: By the word of truth and the power of God, by honour and dishonour, as deceivers and yet true, as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold we live, as poor yet making many rich: that is the secret sauce the spies are looking for, and it is only God's commandments.
precepts.point: Every bomb dropped and every war fought loosens a link in the shackles of our captivity; the Lord is the director of this thing, and we should not be fearful when we see flames.

note.label: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

precepts.why:
“And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another”. Many in the body are here for the wrong reasons: opportunists out to make a quick buck, and some sent by the three-letter boys, the FBI and CIA, to spy out our liberties. But to the pure all things are pure. If you are among us to spy, all you are going to learn is to repent. You will not find us making maps or plotting to take over buildings. You will find no guns, no pimping, no drugs; only the word of God, our weapon of mass destruction. They want to know the secret sauce, and it is always God's commandments.

Paul lays it out: “By the word of truth, by the power of God”. That is how we roll: God's laws, statutes and commandments. “By the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left”: wherever we turn, that is our way.

“By honour and dishonour”: some honour the works, the platforms and the doors opening, and some see it as dishonour. “By evil report and good report”: evil report from some, but our intentions are pure. We are about family, raising our children and taking care of our wives. “As deceivers, and yet true”: those who hate God's commandments call us deceivers, but our word is true.

“As unknown, and yet well known”: they label us black Hebrew extremists as if they know nothing about us, but they know exactly that we are the sons of the living God. “As dying, and, behold, we live”: we are afflicted, and they think we have no life because we keep the Sabbath; but Christ is in us, and we keep more feast days than their wicked holidays and enjoy our families. “As chastened, and not killed; As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich”.

precepts.text: Having these promises, cleanse yourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God. We have wronged no man, corrupted no man, defrauded no man. We do this in the fear of God's judgment.
precepts.point: Come out from among them and be ye separate, touch not the unclean thing, and I will receive you and be a father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters.

note.label: Much Is Given, Much Is Required

precepts.why:
Chapter 6 ends with promises: “I will receive you, And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.” Then Paul says what those promises require: “Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.”

That is why we come out from among them, are separate and touch not the unclean thing. We are not unequally yoked with unbelievers, because righteousness has no fellowship with unrighteousness and light has no communion with darkness. If your best friend is somebody in the world who just finished celebrating Christmas, you are not in the truth, and that goes for you sisters too. You are lying to yourself, just putting on the purple and the fringes.

“Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.” That is the minister who gives no offence in any thing, so that the ministry is not blamed. Do not be the leader who is out there selling drugs, a murderer, a thief, the setback to this.

We cleanse ourselves in the fear of God's judgment. Much is given and much is required. God sent his Son to bear our sins, made us his friends and his ambassadors, and gave us the laws of God. If we then live in hypocrisy, it is not a few stripes for us. Now is the accepted time and now is the day of salvation: are we going to waste it?

precepts.text: Knowing the terror of the Lord, we persuade men. The love of Christ constrains us so that we do not live unto ourselves. If we tell the people to come out of the world and do not live it ourselves, we were profitable to many but not to ourselves, and the punishment fits what we knew.
precepts.point: Come out from among them and be ye separate, touch not the unclean thing, and I will receive you and be a father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters.

note.label: Much Is Given, Much Is Required

precepts.why:
“Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men”. We know the terror of the Lord, so we persuade our people to come out of the world. “For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.”

He made him to bear our sins. So did God send his Son to die so we could keep sinning in hypocrisy? He sent Christ to die for our sins, gave us his laws, and made us friends, prophets and ambassadors. That is why chapter 6 opens “We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.” Let this word be profitable to you, so that you become prophets of God, the women bear prophets back on the earth, and the daughters are righteous.

We do not live unto ourselves. If we tell the people to come out of the world and do not live it ourselves, we were profitable to many but not to ourselves, and the punishment fits what we knew. Much is given, and much is required.

So this is our life. There is no other life outside of this: no friends in the world, nobody else to call. If you have another life where you feel comfortable, you have not been in the truth. The love of Christ constrains us to live unto him.

precepts.text: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed.
precepts.point: Knowing yourself means catching the thought and saying, not today, because you know where it leads.

note.label: Pattern

precepts.why:
“Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves”. Every brother and sister must examine themselves, and nobody can prove you but you. Ask yourself what you are doing that keeps you from growing in the spirit of Christ, and what you need help with. Do not wait until you hit rock bottom. The faith is the scriptures, and you must constantly examine yourself to see that you are still in it, because Satan can bind us while we still think we are in the truth, hardly reading, hardly studying, hardly watching class.

Knowing yourself means knowing your triggers and your weak point. If you are covetous, you should not have a job dealing with money. If you are lustful, you should not be watching certain videos or listening to R&B heavy. Music, movies and social media will lead you to porn. My lust and your lust might be different, but if I know myself, I know mine. So when the thought comes you say, self, we ain't going to do that today, turn it off and meditate on the scriptures. If you do not examine yourself, you are reprobate, and you let Satan use your body to do whatever he wants.

Why does it matter so much? “Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed”. Satan wants us to shame the ministry, and he makes us believe it is just a little thing. But people want to prove us wrong. They are ready to pick at any little thing: see what leadership is doing, see what the brothers and sisters are doing. Satan sets people inside the congregations for this, ready to say, I'm offended, I'm leaving.

Yet offences are everywhere. Solomon offended, and the whole of Israel was not destroyed; Israel still went on. One man's sin does not destroy everything, which is why we pray and fast for our leadership to stay on course. So take every little thing as a big thing, keep examining yourself, and do not go back to sin, so that the ministry is not blamed.

precepts.text: Ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder.
precepts.point: Come out from among them and be ye separate, and I will receive you and be a father unto you. The congregation becomes father and mother to those who come in with no parents to teach them.

note.label: Transforming From Immorality To Beautiful Civility Returning Our Kingdom To An Organized Nation Pt 3

precepts.why:
“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you”. When the brothers teach on the street, that is what they tell our brothers and sisters: come out of the sinful lives you are living in, out of Babylon the great, out of these wicked holidays like Christmas. But if we tell them to come out of something, they have to come into something. They have to have something to say yes to, like righteously enjoying the commandments of the Lord through the high holy days. An organized nation thinks on all of these points and deals with the nation holistically.

They lose their wicked parents and wicked friends when they come in, so the Lord says “I will receive you”, and “will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters”. Your fathers out there did not teach you anything. Your mothers did not teach you anything. So the Lord gives you fathers and mothers in this truth.

That is why Peter says “Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder.” When our brothers and sisters come in, they are going to have to submit to the leadership, to the elders who now stand as their fathers and mothers.

When you are received, you are not abandoned or left out in the cold. You were lost, but now you are found: welcome home. Now we have belonging, now we are loved, wrapped in the Most High's care, and that makes you stand up with esteem and refuse to let mediocrity deter you from the righteous path.

precepts.text: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
precepts.point: Come out from among them and be ye separate, and I will receive you and be a father unto you. The congregation becomes father and mother to those who come in with no parents to teach them.

note.label: Transforming From Immorality To Beautiful Civility Returning Our Kingdom To An Organized Nation Pt 3

precepts.why:
“The elder women as mothers”. The mothers out there did not teach anything. The daughters ran wild, the sons ran wild, and the daddies taught nothing. But the children heard the prophets say, come out of that. So the elder women in this truth become mothers to the sisters who come in without proper guidance. That is the importance of you elders, and why we thank the Lord for the sisters still holding on to righteousness, because Satan went after our sisters and got a lot of them messed up.

“the younger as sisters”: the younger women become sisters to the disenfranchised sisters coming in. A sister who comes in does not know how to put a skirt on, dress properly, carry herself or hold a righteous conversation. She learns from sisters who were guided by proper mothers and fathers in the body. The brothers are the same: we are a proper influence on brothers who came from total dysfunction. And it is to be done “with all purity.”

Sometimes the children get fixed up first and go back home to that sinful family. The parents notice the righteous change and ask the reason of the hope that is in them: where did you learn this respect for me, when I have been nothing but a bad father or mother to you? Then those parents come in and become repentant mothers and fathers.

This is how the Lord keeps his word, “I will receive you”, and “will be a Father unto you”. The whole nation, men and women, elder mothers and elder brothers, becomes the family we all need, and when you marry, you carry it on to your children through your generations.

precepts.point: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me. We must understand what we read; this is a renewing of the mind, like Nicodemus asking how a man can be born again.

note.label: Psalm 51: Acknowledge, Repent, and Be Cleansed

precepts.why:
“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you”. Come out of her, my people, and be ye separate. A clean heart and a right spirit mean not being conformed to this world.

If you do only what you want to do, you are conformed to this world and to your own god. The renewing of the mind is coming out from among them and not touching the unclean thing; then the Most High receives you. That is the clean heart David prayed for.

precepts.text: Be ye not unequally yoked with unbelievers, for there is no fellowship between righteousness and unrighteousness, nor concord between Christ and Belial.
precepts.point: The mischief framed by law is men marrying men, women marrying women, setting the new year in the midst of winter to have us worshiping another god, and coexist meaning you can serve any gods you want.

note.label: Psalm 94: The God of Vengeance and Defense of His People

precepts.why:
The throne of iniquity shall have no fellowship with the Most High, and neither should we have fellowship with it. “Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness? And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?”

Be ye not unequally yoked with unbelievers, for there is no fellowship between righteousness and unrighteousness, nor concord between Christ and Belial. The same word, fellowship, that Psalm 94 asks about the throne that frames mischief by law is the word Paul uses for us.

If the power that makes men marry men and sets the new year in the midst of winter has no fellowship with God, then he that believes has no part with it either.

precepts.text: We are the temple of the living God; He does not say He is the God of all people, so come out from among them, be ye separate, and touch not the unclean thing.
precepts.point: The mischief framed by law is men marrying men, women marrying women, setting the new year in the midst of winter to have us worshiping another god, and coexist meaning you can serve any gods you want.

note.label: Psalm 94: The God of Vengeance and Defense of His People

precepts.why:
“And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.” We are the temple of the living God. Notice he does not say he is the God of all people; he says I will be their God and they shall be my people.

“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you”. Come out from among them, be ye separate, and touch not the unclean thing.

That is the answer to Psalm 94:20. The throne that frames mischief by a law, men marrying men, the new year set in the midst of winter, coexist with any god you want, has no fellowship with the Most High, so his temple comes out from among it and is separate, and he receives us.

precepts.text: By the word of truth, by honor and dishonor, as chastened and not killed; the prophets and the apostle Paul agree with what we read in the psalm.
precepts.point: The Lord has chastened me sore but has not given me over unto death. When you come to serve the Lord, understand that this walk brings chastising to try us.

note.label: Psalm 118: His Mercy Endureth For Ever

precepts.why:
“By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left, By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true; As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed”.

“as chastened, and not killed” is the psalm word for word in the apostle's mouth: “The Lord hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.” “as dying, and, behold, we live” is “I shall not die, but live”. The prophets and the apostle Paul agree with what we read in the psalm: this walk brings honour and dishonour, evil report and good report, chastening but not death.

note.label: The Last Man Standing

precepts.why:
“Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed”. Some of you brothers may have done things in your past, maybe statutory rape at seventeen with a fifteen-year-old, or worse, and when you are a sex offender you register, and some have stipulations not to be around children. We have kids upstairs, and we don't want to give nobody a reason to try to shut us down. We are not going to put your business out in the air, humiliate you or try to destroy you, but give us the heads-up.

That is what we are trying to avoid: we don't want the ministry blamed, and our first thing is to make sure this truth continues. You are trying to hide your sins, like the brother who said he couldn't come on the Sabbath because he was on a cruise, and when it was looked up it was an LGBT cruise: I didn't know until I got on. That's a damn lie. Some of y'all know what you are battling with. We are not trying to judge or condemn anybody; we are saying discipline those spirits more.

A brother who was put out of the school for beating his wife went months later to buy a prostitute who turned out to be a transvestite, and shot the person, and it was all over the news. He was not part of us, and they dug into his past to blame the ministry anyway. That is why you all have to bring those lusts under control, and second and third offenders will have to stay online and watch.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
Christ spoke through Paul and said the same thing in the New Testament: “Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers”. Some of you find somebody in the world who floats your boat; you know they don’t believe like you, but you think you can make it work, and it always ends badly.

As a society we try to join with Christians and with Muslims, knowing they don’t believe like we believe and nobody keeps any commandments. That is an ungodly alliance. “For what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness? And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?” An infidel is an unbeliever.

“And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God”. Why are you joined with this man or this woman who are idolaters? “Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you”.

We don’t believe like Christians. They worship a figment of their imagination that does not exist in the Bible, the image the oppressors forced on our ancestors. We believe the true Bible and the true God.

note.label: The Acts Of The Apostles & Foundation Through Christ

precepts.why:
“We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.” Paul is talking to the Corinthians. “(For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)”

We just read who that salvation was for in Isaiah 49. Now Paul is hitting the Corinthians with it. This is the fulfilment of that prophecy, so the Corinthians have to be those same people in Isaiah 49.

Verse 11: “O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you”. That prophecy was talking about you, showing you that the Corinthians have to be Israelites.

note.label: Amalek and the Liberal Agenda

precepts.why:
Christ said it too: separate. We understand you got to work, you got to make a living; that’s not what the law is talking about. Once you leave your job, separate: he or she ain’t got to be over your house trying to marry your sister, your brother. And the ones watching that are sincere and really want to help: just send money. We don’t need no other help from you.

“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers”: that’s our own unbelieving people too, because they got the mind of the white man, they got the mind of Esau; they will incorporate, assimilate, all of that. “For what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness? And what concord hath Christ with Belial?” Belial is the devil. “Or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?” And you sisters better understand, because y’all are the first ones to run out there and marry some unbelieving negro, then he’s popping you upside the head, bringing other women in the house, and you come to us crying.
